searchText: Not sure if the right channel for this but I've been wondering: what is the current state of VDFs and applications to eth? Any way to get involved or learn more? refs: https://twitter.com/badcryptobitch/status/1523683367363149824 https://twitter.com/bryan_gillespie/status/1519145775967649793 I have a bit of background in VDFs but would love to know if anyone is currently working on VDFs or other delay crypto (witness encryption seems **very** promising for related use cases?), whether it's implementation, protocol design, applications, or theory
